scope: Make generated DXF MESH parsing allocation-safe for the bounded vertex, face-list, and per-face index vectors while preserving same-group retry after reserve failure.

changes: Before committing group-93 parser state, reserve an aggregate-bounded number of face slots using the minimum four group-90 items per triangular face.
When opening a face from group 90, reserve its validated index count before advancing the pending-index cursor; remove the just-created empty face if reserve fails.
Keep the existing maximum item limit and exception-catching DRW::reserve path.
implementation.failureBehavior: A failed vector reservation returns false without committing the associated count/cursor transition; the same group can be retried on the same MESH parser object.

coverage: Injected failure at group 92 vertex reserve leaves vertices empty and permits corrected group-92 retry.
Injected failure at group 93 face-list reserve leaves faces empty and permits corrected group-93 retry.
Injected failure while opening a group-90 face rolls back the empty face and permits the same group-90 retry followed by all three indices.

limitations: This protects DXF parser state and allocation behavior; it does not qualify physical MESH producer profiles or native geometry semantics.
It does not resolve the separate DWG MESH trailing-field layout conflict.
